scope: This is the minimal interpretation correction for C09 of the frozen same-tick composition checklist. It changes only how an unreachable final-only failure is proven; C01-C08 and C10-C12, the exact physics.cpp-only future production allowlist, rollback semantics, thresholds and public APIs remain unchanged.

proof_of_unreachability.child_invariants: A successful legacy prefix has already passed its finite-state, finite-energy and per-island energy checks; a successful D6-A tail has checked every BallState field for finiteness before returning.
proof_of_unreachability.merge_invariant: The mixed composition copies at most 16 already-validated float BallState values into a staged GameState. Summing their finite kinetic terms in double cannot overflow solely because of the bounded ball count and float range.
proof_of_unreachability.conclusion: A public final-only NonfiniteState or NonfiniteEnergy failure after both children succeed has no honest reachable fixture. Tests may not manufacture one through invalid input, mismatched duration or boundary mode, or a production-resident injection seam.

rejected_alternatives.production_test_hook: Forbidden: no compile-time or runtime failure-injection hook, test macro, callback, environment variable or public/private bypass seam may be added to production.
rejected_alternatives.kinetic_only_gravity_failure: Forbidden: an airborne ball's kinetic-energy increase caused by loss of gravitational potential energy is not PassiveEnergyCreation.
rejected_alternatives.mismatched_subrequest: Forbidden: a short ProductionTable tail may not be used to claim coverage for a different long or Unbounded final-failure request.
rejected_alternatives.threshold_change: Forbidden: passive-energy, TOI, residual, penetration, gravity or event-budget thresholds and formulas may not be loosened to create or hide a failure.

corrected_c09_acceptance.runtime_failure_stages: Before-prefix, handoff-validation, D6-tail and later-legacy failures remain real public executions with exact failure code, empty committed telemetry/private events and byte-exact pre-tick rollback.
corrected_c09_acceptance.final_gate_static_contract: The tests extract the complete production composition function structurally, and prove exactly one final staged finite/energy validation occurs after successful prefix/tail/later-work merge and before the only state commit and telemetry publication. Its failure branch restores the snapshot and clears every canonical contact, solver, surface, analytic, crossing and attestation ledger.
source_mutations_exact: move final validator after state commit
move final validator before tail merge
retain any canonical telemetry ledger on failure
replace gravity-aware accounting with kinetic-only comparison
multiply tolerance by a private D6 event count
add a production test hook or conditional bypass
corrected_c09_acceptance.gravity_runtime_control: For an isolated airborne no-contact path, independently compute K plus gravitational potential U=-m*g_y*y using SI conversion at entry and exit. Mechanical energy may not increase beyond the unchanged public passive-energy tolerance, while kinetic energy is required to increase on descent. The composed public request must succeed rather than report PassiveEnergyCreation.
corrected_c09_acceptance.same_request_success_control: The same initial state, whole duration and ProductionTable boundary used by the composition fixture must independently demonstrate the real legacy prefix, the exact remaining D6 tail, later legacy work and a successful final validation/commit when no genuine failure exists.
